hooks.command: bash -c 'r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; git -C "$r" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$r" config --local user.name Patrickpoix && git -C "$r" config --local user.email 121714433+Patrickpoix@users.noreply.github.com || exit 1; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ]; then printf "%s\n" "export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Patrickpoix" "export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=121714433+Patrickpoix@users.noreply.github.com" "export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Patrickpoix" "export GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=121714433+Patrickpoix@users.noreply.github.com" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi'
